title: Checkpoint
tagline: Visit local businesses, complete challenges, and earn on-chain rewards.

prizes.title: Best dApp built on Saga Chainlet

description: Checkpoint is a mobile Web3 gaming platform that bridges the physical and digital worlds. Players explore their local neighborhoods, visit real businesses, and earn on-chain rewards, all without needing blockchain knowledge. Built on Saga's dedicated chainlet with Thirdweb authentication and Unity Engine, Checkpoint delivers a seamless Web2-like experience with gasless transactions. The platform gamifies local exploration while driving foot traffic to participating businesses, creating a sustainable economy that benefits both players and local communities.
how_its_made:
This project uses a dedicated blockchain network for gasless transactions and high-speed performance, powered by Saga. The smart contracts were developed with Solidity and Foundry.
We use ThirdWeb for simplified wallet creation and authentication with familiar Web2 login patterns.
